== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Magnetic Suction Tube (Dark)]] and [[Magnetic Suction Tube (Dark) (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0 / Supplement). Appendix A matches, so (PC Errata) is reclassed to (Errata). Do not mix [[Magnetic Suction Tube]]. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata (omit missing). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
